o: Welcome to another season of adventures with Zed, Addison, and the rest of the Seabrook crew - plus a mischievous new student who’s bound to make this senior redo even wilder.

v.n: ZOMBIES: The Re-Animated Series Season 2 Official Trailer!…

eps.o: Fiona shows up for her first day at Seabrook High.
A butterfly swarm threatens Zed's coronation.
Wynter takes on a more serious identity.
Fiona falls in love with Bun-kins and brings them to life.
Zed and Bucky bond over their love of Prawx.
The kids try to keep Addison away from game night.
Zoey becomes a detective rookie recruit for a project.
Willa asks Demón to help her in improv class.
Willa is a superstar scorer in Luma Ball.
Addison has her clone go see a horror movie with Bree.
When the monsters from Dae's spooky stories come to life, she must save Seabrook.
Bree tries to make her viewers smile despite the Skullberries.

eps.t: The Z-O-M-B-I-E-S: The Re-Animated Series Karaoke Singalong Spectacular
eps.o: Zed and friends must sing for demons.
